messages:
ana: Daily check-in — what I did: drafted the benchmark post, added hero image to /assets, uploaded sample outputs. Blockers: waiting on eng review for the embed/code snippet and a quick alt-text check from design. Today: finalize draft, fix any PR comments, lock launch time.

mike: Nice. Can you drop the PR link? I'll line up the boosted post after we go live. Also need the canonical slug + tags.

ana: (typo) meant ana: PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/482  — bench script outputs pasted below.

jin: @ana thanks — grabbing the PR. Quick Q: do you have the raw numbers for p50/p95 and tokens/sec? I want to call out exact figures in the tweet.

ana: pasted: ```
Latency p50: 210ms
Latency p95: 530ms
Tokens/sec: 44
Cost per 1k tokens: $0.012
```

mike: OK good. /deploy bench-posts staging? We should smoke-test the embed and the OG image on staging before launch. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to staging for branch bench-posts at 10:30 PT. Watch the channel for status.

sarah: For launch window — calendar currently shows product demo at 10:45 PT so can we aim for 11:00 PT go-live? That gives eng time to review. :calendar:

jin: 11:00 PT works for me. I'll try to finish the review by 10:15 PT and leave comments inline. If I hit a blocker I'll ping @eng and escalate.

lex: design check — saw the hero, making a tiny alt-text tweak and contrast tweak. Pushing a new asset @ 09:50 PT.

mike: Great. Final asks from me: confirm slug + tags and if there are any embargo rules for partners. I'll draft the social posts and schedule the boosted campaign once we have final copy.

ana: slug: /benchmarks/real-world-inference-costs ; tags: [cost, latency, case-study]. No partner embargo.

mike: Cool, I'll queue socials for 11:05 PT. Thanks everyone :rocket:

ana: Thanks all — will address PR comments now. Ping me if you need anything before 10:15.

jin: Got it. Will report back when review is done.

deploy-bot: Deploy to staging finished: success. Preview: https://staging.redwood.com/benchmarks/real-world-inference-costs

sarah: Preview looks good, OG image renders fine. We're green for 11:00 PT.
